root_cause: The datepicker component (via vanilla-calendar-pro's inputMode keyboard handling) intercepts Tab keydown on the input element and calls preventDefault(), blocking default browser focus movement to the next form field.
repair_strategy: Add a keydown event listener on the input element that detects Tab key, hides the datepicker calendar, and allows default browser behavior (focus movement) to proceed without preventDefault. Clean up the listener on dispose.
expected_accessibility_effect: Tab key now moves focus from departure date field to passengers field as expected in standard form navigation, restoring keyboard accessibility for form traversal per WCAG 2.1.1 and 2.4.3.
functional_risks: Minimal - only affects Tab key behavior when datepicker is shown
Arrow key navigation within calendar remains intact
verification_requirements: Arrow keys still navigate calendar dates when open
Escape still closes calendar (existing regression guard)
Form submission works with entered values
